Dear Ms. Knox,

Re: Account reference: ACC-261859

We acknowledge receipt of your dispute regarding the account referenced above. You have asserted that you paid off the account in full and that the original creditor, Liberty Credit Corp, informed you that the balance was $3,300.00. You also stated that you requested a refund for the overpayment, but it was never sent to you.

We are investigating your claim and will review the account history to determine the accuracy of your statements. As per the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA), we are required to provide you with a validation of the debt if you dispute the amount owed. However, in this case, you have not requested validation, and we will proceed with investigating your hardship dispute.

Please be advised that we will review the account history and provide a response to your dispute within the next 30 days. If we determine that the account was indeed paid off in full, we will take the necessary steps to update the account status and cease collection efforts.

You have the right to further dispute this account if you believe additional information is necessary. Please contact us at your earliest convenience to discuss further.

Sincerely,

Crestview Financial Recovery
